text:
The suspect should be found not guilty if the jury believes his account, because the statute bars force only when a person knows or should know he is being arrested, and here the officer’s unlawful excessive force after the arrest would justify self-defense against that force. Under the officer’s account, however, the suspect used force to resist a lawful arrest and would be guilty, so the outcome turns on whose version the factfinder credits.  
CONFIDENCE: 85
